INSERT INTO event.calls_for_proposals
               (event_id, code, title, status, opens_at, closes_at, required_reviews)
           VALUES ($1, 'principal',
                   '{"fr":"Appel à propositions","en":"Call for proposals"}'::jsonb,
                   'open', now() - interval '1 day', now() + interval '30 days', 2)
        RETURNING id
